lab_questions.title: Simulate Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache
lab_questions.description:
High-performance data layer services rely on a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with fixed key capacity C to minimize database latency. When the cache hits capacity and a new key is added, the least recently accessed key is evicted.

Read C (cache capacity) and Q (number of cache operations). Each operation is either 'PUT key value' or 'GET key'. For every GET operation, output the key's value if present, or -1 if the key has been evicted or does not exist.
